blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Barangays in Cebu City are being urged to strengthen their role in substance abuse prevention and rehabilitation, including helping persons who use drugs and those recovering from such use access treatment, rehabilitation and community-based support. Barangay officials and partner agencies recently signed a Pledge of Commitment, promising to support the city’s anti-drug initiatives and work together in implementing prevention, treatment, rehabilitation, and recovery programs within their communities. The commitment followed discussions on the responsibilities of Barangay Anti-Drug Abuse Councils (BADACs), including their role in implementing the Barangay Drug Clearing Program (BDCP), establishing rehabilitation desks, and assisting residents […]...
